334	\section{Design}
335	% 设计
336	\label{sec:design}
337	
338	The three requirements (cross-layer resource projection, stable tags, and hierarchical attribution) drive the design.
339	% 三个需求（跨层资源投影、稳定标签和分层归因）驱动了设计。
340	Operations (\S\ref{sec:ops}) satisfy R1 by representing intent and system-effect activities in a single record with tag inheritance, so intent-layer tags propagate to the system effects they trigger.
341	% Operation（\S\ref{sec:ops}）通过将意图和系统副作用活动表示在带标签继承的单一记录中满足 R1，使意图层标签传播到其触发的系统副作用。
342	\emph{Intent attribution} (\S\ref{sec:intent}) satisfies R2 by deriving stable tags from natural-language fields.
343	% 意图归因（\S\ref{sec:intent}）通过从自然语言字段派生稳定标签满足 R2。
344	\emph{Operation stacks} (\S\ref{sec:stacks}) satisfy R3 by replacing the runtime call stack with query-time field projections that attribute resources at multiple levels of granularity, so the same data supports multiple views without rebuilding the input.
345	% Operation stack（\S\ref{sec:stacks}）通过以查询时字段投影替代运行时调用栈，在多个粒度层级归因资源来满足 R3，使同一数据支持多种视图而无需重建输入。
346	The profiling pipeline has four stages: (1)~parse raw trajectories into operations, (2)~enrich operations via intent attribution or mapping rules, (3)~project each operation onto a stack frame sequence chosen at query time, and (4)~fold operations with identical stacks, summing their weights.
347	% 分析管线有四个阶段：(1) 将原始轨迹解析为 operation，(2) 通过意图归因或映射规则丰富 operation，(3) 将每个 operation 投影到查询时选择的栈帧序列上，(4) 折叠具有相同栈的 operation 并求和权重。
348	
349	\subsection{Semantic Operation Stack Model}
350	% 语义 Operation Stack 模型
351	\label{sec:ops}
352	
353	%% ¶1: Operations
354	Because agent activities span both the intent and system-effect
355	layers described in \S\ref{sec:background}, a profiler should not
356	distinguish between them in the data representation.
357	% 由于智能体活动跨越 \S\ref{sec:background} 中描述的意图层和系统副作用层，分析器不应在数据表示层面区分它们。
358	\sys therefore represents every activity as a single abstraction, the
359	\operation, a weighted record with string fields and additive
360	measures.
361	% 因此 \sys 将每个活动表示为单一抽象——operation，一个带有字符串字段和可加度量的加权记录。
362	Each operation carries string fields (\texttt{project},
363	\texttt{agent}, \texttt{session}, \texttt{prompt\_tag},
364	\texttt{kind}, \texttt{model}, \texttt{path}, \texttt{domain},
365	\texttt{status}, \ldots) and additive measures (token count,
366	duration, event count).
367	% 每个 operation 携带字符串字段（\texttt{project}、\texttt{agent}、\texttt{session}、\texttt{prompt\_tag}、\texttt{kind}、\texttt{model}、\texttt{path}、\texttt{domain}、\texttt{status} 等）和可加度量（token 数、持续时间、事件数）。
368	A prompt, an LLM call, a tool invocation, a file read, a GUI click,
369	and a process event are all operations with the same schema, distinguished only by which fields carry values.
370	% 提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用、文件读取、GUI 点击和进程事件都是具有相同 schema 的 operation，仅通过哪些字段有值来区分。
371	
372	%% ¶2: Operation Stacks
373	\label{sec:stacks}
374	An \opstack provides hierarchical attribution for agent trajectories, replacing the runtime call stack.
375	% 一个 operation stack 为智能体轨迹提供分层归因，替代运行时调用栈。
376	In CPU profiling, the call stack determines which code paths
377	share responsibility for a resource cost.
378	% 在 CPU 分析中，调用栈决定哪些代码路径共同承担资源开销。
379	An operation stack serves the same role: an ordered list of fields
380	$[f_1, f_2, \ldots, f_k]$ projects each operation $o$ to a frame
381	sequence $\langle o.f_1, o.f_2, \ldots, o.f_k \rangle$, and
382	operations with identical sequences are merged, summing their
383	weights.
384	% Operation stack 承担相同角色：有序字段列表 $[f_1, f_2, \ldots, f_k]$ 将每个 operation $o$ 投影到帧序列 $\langle o.f_1, o.f_2, \ldots, o.f_k \rangle$，具有相同序列的 operation 被合并，权重求和。
385	Unlike a call stack, the fields are chosen at query time, not
386	determined by execution.
387	% 与调用栈不同，字段在查询时选择，而非由执行决定。
388	The same operations can therefore be attributed as a flat task summary, a
389	per-session tree, a semantic phase/action hierarchy, or a
390	trajectory using the dataset's own annotations, and changing the fields changes the
391	attribution without changing the data.
392	% 因此同一组 operation 可归因为扁平任务摘要、固定会话树、语义阶段/操作层次或使用数据集自身标签的轨迹，改变字段即改变归因方式而无需改变数据。
393	Sessions and spans are optional operation fields, not fixed hierarchy levels, so the same data supports both debugging views
394	(include \texttt{session}) and aggregate profiling views (exclude
395	it).
396	% 会话和 span 是可选的 operation 字段而非固定层次级别，因此同一数据既支持调试视图（包含 \texttt{session}）也支持聚合 profiling 视图（排除它）。
397	A view is a triple $(\varphi, \sigma, w)$: a predicate
398	$\varphi$ selects which operations participate, a stack function
399	$\sigma = [f_1, \ldots, f_k]$ maps each operation to its frame
400	sequence, and a weight function $w$ assigns a nonnegative measure.

434	\subsection{Algorithms}
435	% 算法
436	\label{sec:intent}
437	
438	\paragraph{Intent attribution.}
439	% 意图归因。
440	Intent attribution maps natural-language prompts to short, stable,
441	repeatable tags, giving agent trajectories the stable identifiers that traditional
442	profiling gets for free from function names
443	(\S\ref{sec:background}).
444	% 意图归因将自然语言的提示词映射为短小、稳定、可重复的标签，为智能体轨迹提供传统 profiling 从函数名免费获得的稳定标识符（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
445	The framework supports three pluggable backends.
446	% 该框架支持三种可插拔后端。
447	Regex rules are the production default: rules have the form
448	\texttt{KIND:TAG=REGEX}, are evaluated in order (first match wins),
449	and the developer iterates with \sys until the unmatched rate drops
450	below 5\%, typically in 5--10 rounds.
451	% 正则规则是生产环境默认：规则格式为 \texttt{KIND:TAG=REGEX}，按顺序求值（首个匹配胜出），开发者与 \sys 迭代直到未匹配率降至 5\% 以下，通常需要 5--10 轮。
452	A local LLM tagger (e.g., a quantized 3B-parameter model via llama.cpp)
453	generates a single-word tag per prompt with grammar-constrained
454	decoding (forcing output to match a predefined token grammar) and caching.
455	% 本地 LLM 标注器（如通过 llama.cpp 运行的量化 3B 参数模型）通过语法约束解码（强制输出匹配预定义 token 语法）和缓存为每个提示词生成单词标签。
456	Unsupervised clustering via TF-IDF and K-Means discovers
457	natural prompt groups without predefined rules, feeding rule
458	authoring.
459	% 通过 TF-IDF 和 K-Means 的无监督聚类在没有预定义规则的情况下发现自然提示词分组，为规则编写提供输入。
460	For structured trajectories where action types and quality annotations are
461	explicit fields, mapping rules derive new fields from existing
462	ones (e.g., \texttt{phase:navigate=type:(click|scroll|key)}).
463	% 对于操作类型和质量标注是显式字段的结构化轨迹，映射规则从现有字段派生新字段（如 \texttt{phase:navigate=type:(click|scroll|key)}）。
464	All backends are pluggable, and a profiling configuration records the
465	complete analysis setup for deterministic replay.
466	% 所有后端都是可插拔的，profiling configuration 记录完整的分析配置以实现确定性重放。
467	
468	\paragraph{Stack construction.}
469	% 栈构造。
470	Stack construction builds attribution hierarchies from
471	available fields.
472	% 栈构造从可用字段构建归因层次。
473	When users supply an ordered list of fields, the projection is direct.
474	% 当用户提供有序字段列表时，投影是直接的。
475	When no field list is supplied, \sys can induce operation stacks
476	automatically by scoring adjacent operations for topic changes,
477	field changes, and group consistency, then cutting at boundaries
478	where the evidence is strongest.
479	% 当不提供有序字段列表时，\sys 可以通过对相邻 operation 评分主题变化、字段变化和分组一致性来自动诱导 operation stack，然后在证据最强的边界处切分。
480	The induced stacks have variable depth, and a configurable depth cap
481	controls the granularity.
482	% 诱导的栈具有可变深度，可配置的深度上限控制粒度。
483	This mode produces coarser groups than hand-specified stacks but
484	requires no domain knowledge, making it useful for initial
485	exploration (\S\ref{sec:eval}).
486	% 此模式产生比手动指定栈更粗的分组，但不需要领域知识，适用于初始探索（\S\ref{sec:eval}）。
487

489	\section{Implementation}
490	% 实现
491	\label{sec:impl}
492	
493	\sys is an offline, post-hoc profiler implemented as a Rust CLI (Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}).
494	% \sys 是一个离线、事后分析器，实现为 Rust CLI（Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}）。
495	It reads recorded trajectories, not live events.
496	% 它读取记录的轨迹，而非实时事件。
497	The \texttt{agent-session} crate reads Codex and Claude Code local JSONL history files and reconstructs prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations, and their triggered file and network effects.
498	% \texttt{agent-session} crate 读取 Codex 和 Claude Code 本地 JSONL 历史文件，重建提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用及其触发的文件和网络副作用。
499	Each prompt opens a span.
500	% 每个提示词打开一个 span。
501	LLM calls, tool calls, and system effects within that span inherit its semantic tag, connecting intent to system behavior without runtime instrumentation.
502	% 该 span 内的 LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用继承其语义标签，无需运行时插桩即可连接意图与系统行为。
503	Public benchmark datasets enter as operation JSONL with mapping rules deriving fields before stack construction.
504	% 公开基准数据集以 operation JSONL 形式进入，映射规则在栈构建之前派生字段。
505	Standard Chrome Trace Event format can also be imported, with non-\sys protocol fields preserved as operation fields.
506	% 标准 Chrome Trace Event 格式也可导入，非 \sys 协议字段作为 operation 字段保留。
507	
508	Output formats include pprof protobuf (compatible with \texttt{go tool pprof -http}), folded-stack text (compatible with \texttt{flamegraph.pl}), standalone SVG flame graphs, and JSON summaries.
509	% 输出格式包括 pprof protobuf（兼容 \texttt{go tool pprof -http}）、折叠栈文本（兼容 \texttt{flamegraph.pl}）、独立 SVG 火焰图和 JSON 摘要。
510	Operations can also be exported as standard Chrome Trace Event JSON and re-imported with byte-identical folded output, enabling interoperability with trace viewers such as Perfetto.
511	% Operation 也可以导出为标准 Chrome Trace Event JSON 并重新导入，折叠输出字节相同，支持与 Perfetto 等 trace 查看器的互操作。
512	All outputs are deterministic given the same input and profiling configuration.
513	% 在相同输入和 profiling configuration 下，所有输出都是确定性的。
514	
515	\sys is the offline profiling component of the AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} observability framework.
516	% \sys 是 AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} 可观测性框架的离线分析组件。
517	AgentSight provides real-time eBPF-based capture of SSL traffic, process events, and file/network effects.
518	% AgentSight 提供基于 eBPF 的实时 SSL 流量、进程事件和文件/网络副作用捕获。
519	\sys aggregates the recorded trajectories into semantic profiles, so the two are complementary: AgentSight answers ``what happened during this run'' (debugging), and \sys answers ``where did the budget go across runs'' (profiling).
520	% \sys 将记录的轨迹聚合为语义概要，因此两者互补：AgentSight 回答"这次运行发生了什么"（调试），\sys 回答"预算跨运行花在了哪里"（分析）。

524	% 评估
525	\label{sec:eval}
526	
527	We use two classes of data.
528	% 我们使用两类数据。
529	\textbf{Real agent trajectories}: 325 readable local trajectories (198~Codex, 50~Claude, 77~Claude subagent) from a multi-month development project, containing 183{,}714 system observations.
530	% 真实智能体会话：来自一个多月开发项目的 325 个可读本地会话（198 个 Codex、50 个 Claude、77 个 Claude 子智能体），包含 183,714 个系统观测。
531	\textbf{Public annotated trajectories}: 15 families of real agent or human executions, totaling 47{,}590 operations through mapping rules.
532	% 公开标注轨迹：15 个真实智能体或人类执行的家族，通过映射规则共计 47,590 个 operation。
533	These cover web agents (WebLINX~\cite{weblinx}, Mind2Web~\cite{mind2web}, AgentTrek~\cite{agenttrek}, WebShop~\cite{webshop}), API agents (API-Bank~\cite{apibank}, ToolBench~\cite{toolbench}, tau-bench~\cite{taubench}), coding agents (SWE-agent~\cite{sweagent}), and mobile/GUI agents (AndroidCtrl~\cite{androidcontrol}, GUI-Odyssey~\cite{guiodyssey}, ScaleCUA~\cite{scalecua}).
534	% 涵盖 web 智能体（WebLINX、Mind2Web、AgentTrek、WebShop）、API 智能体（API-Bank、ToolBench、tau-bench）、编码智能体（SWE-agent）和移动/GUI 智能体（AndroidCtrl、GUI-Odyssey、ScaleCUA）。
535	Four families with ground-truth quality annotations (AgentRewardBench~\cite{agentrewardbench}, SATraj-OS~\cite{safactory}, AgentNet~\cite{agentnet}, OSWorld-Human~\cite{osworldhuman}) provide hidden annotations for RQ2.
536	% 四个具有真实质量标注的家族（AgentRewardBench、SATraj-OS、AgentNet、OSWorld-Human）为 RQ2 提供隐藏标签。
537	We measure semantic separation via the mixed-weight percentage defined in RQ1.
538	% 我们通过 RQ1 中定义的混合权重百分比测量语义分离度。
539	For localization quality (RQ2), we use average precision (AP, the area under the precision-recall curve when groups are ranked by suspected problem density), recall at various inspection budgets, and work-to-first-positive (the fraction of groups inspected before finding one positive).
540	% 对于定位质量（RQ2），我们使用平均精度（AP，按疑似问题密度排序分组时精确率-召回率曲线下面积）、不同检查预算下的召回率和首个正例工作量（找到一个正例前检查的分组比例）。
541	For tag agreement (RQ3), we use V-measure (a clustering-agreement score ranging from 0 to 1) and boundary F1.
542	% 对于标签一致性（RQ3），我们使用 V-measure（聚类一致性分数，范围 0 到 1）和边界 F1。

545	\subsection{RQ1: Does Semantic Profiling Improve Resource Attribution?}
546	% RQ1：语义分析能否改善资源归因？
547	
548	The strongest argument against semantic profiling is that traditional tools ``can already see the same information.''
549	% 反对语义分析的最强论点是传统工具"已经能看到相同信息"。
550	To test this, we run a semantic-axis ablation on 325 real Codex/Claude trajectories (183{,}714 system observations).
551	% 为了检验这一点，我们在 325 个真实 Codex/Claude 会话（183,714 个系统观测）上进行语义轴消融。
552	We progressively add tag axes (no tags, session only, prompt only, both) and measure the mixed-weight percentage, the fraction of system-effect cost in groups that mix observations from multiple task categories.
553	% 我们逐步添加标签轴（无标签、仅会话、仅提示词、两者兼有），测量混合权重百分比——混合了多个任务类别观测的桶中的系统副作用权重比例。
554	A lower mixed-weight percentage means the profiler correctly separates effects by task category.
555	% 更低的混合权重百分比意味着分析器正确地按任务类别分离了效果。
556	The residual percentage measures weight in groups where the majority category accounts for less than 90\% of the group, capturing partial mixing.
557	% 残余百分比测量多数类别占桶内不到 90\% 的权重，捕获部分混合。
558	
559	Figure~\ref{fig:rq1-separation} shows the result.
560	% Figure~\ref{fig:rq1-separation} 展示了结果。
561	Without semantic tags, nearly all system-effect cost falls into mixed groups: a flat \texttt{cargo~test} counter shows 2{,}903 executions but cannot distinguish whether they came from \texttt{review}, \texttt{debug}, \texttt{refactor}, or \texttt{test} prompts.
562	% 没有语义标签时，几乎所有系统副作用权重落入混合桶：扁平的 \texttt{cargo test} 计数器显示 2,903 次执行，但无法区分来源。
563	The prompt tag is the decisive axis: it drops both mixed weight and residual by more than half and nearly doubles the number of unique stacks, because it separates observations that share the same system call but originate from different task intents.
564	% 提示词标签是决定性轴：它将混合权重和残余都降低一半以上，唯一栈数量几乎翻倍，因为它分离了共享相同系统调用但来自不同任务意图的观测。
565	The session tag alone barely helps because trajectories typically contain multiple intent phases.
566	% 仅会话标签几乎没有帮助，因为会话通常包含多个意图阶段。
567	
568	A tag-permutation test (1{,}000 shuffles, $p = 0.001$) confirms the separation is not random.
569	% 标签置换测试（1,000 次洗牌，$p = 0.001$）确认分离不是随机的。
570	Semantic-tag quality is validated in RQ3.
571	% 语义标签质量在 RQ3 中验证。
572	This confirms that traditional tag-free tools cannot separate system effects by task intent; the prompt-level semantic tag is necessary for meaningful resource attribution.
573	% 这确认了传统无标签工具无法按任务意图分离系统副作用；提示词级语义标签对于有意义的资源归因是必要的。
574	
575	Beyond tag separation, we test whether choosing different field selections for the operation stack produces views that flat grouping cannot.
576	% 除标签分离外，我们还测试为 operation stack 选择不同字段是否产生扁平分组无法产生的视图。
577	We take the same 13{,}265 operations from the four families with ground-truth annotations and fold them with five different field selections, counting how many distinct groups each produces.
578	% 我们取四个有真实标注的家族的同样 13,265 个 operation，用五种不同字段选择折叠，计算每种产生多少不同分组。
579	The same operations fold into 9~dataset groups, 57~phase groups, 226~semantic groups, 455~action groups, or 3{,}757~per-session groups by changing only the stack fields.
580	% 同样的 operation 仅通过改变栈字段即可折叠为 9 个数据集分组、57 个阶段分组、226 个语义分组、455 个操作分组或 3,757 个固定会话分组。
581	A flat GROUP BY on a single tag cannot produce these views because different stack depths answer different questions (budget by task vs.\ duplication by action vs.\ per-session detail).
582	% 单标签的扁平 GROUP BY 无法产生这些视图，因为不同栈深度回答不同问题（任务级预算 vs. 操作级重复 vs. 会话级下钻）。
583	The same model also covers all 15 public trajectory families without type-specific objects.
584	% 同一模型也覆盖了所有 15 个公开轨迹家族，无需特定类型对象。
585	This shows that operation stacks provide a multi-resolution view that flat grouping cannot: one model answers questions at dataset, phase, action, and session granularity by changing only the field selection.
586	% 这表明 operation stack 提供了扁平分组无法实现的多分辨率视图：一个模型仅通过改变字段选择就能在数据集、阶段、操作和会话粒度上回答问题。
587	
588	A profiler that supports only one weight function (e.g., token count) might miss bottlenecks visible under a different metric. We test whether different weight functions produce redundant or distinct rankings on the same trajectories.
589	% 只支持一种权重函数（如 token 数）的分析器可能遗漏在另一指标下可见的瓶颈。我们测试不同权重函数在相同会话上产生冗余还是不同的排名。
590	The \texttt{time} and \texttt{tokens} views of the same 325 trajectories share only 7/10 top prompt categories (Spearman $\rho = 0.623$).
591	% 同一 325 个会话的 \texttt{time} 和 \texttt{tokens} 视图仅共享 7/10 的顶级提示词类别（Spearman $\rho = 0.623$）。
592	\texttt{network}-tagged prompts rank 8th by time (I/O wait) but 93rd by tokens.
593	% \texttt{network} 标记的提示词按时间排第 8（I/O 等待）但按 token 排第 93。
594	The rankings are not redundant: a single weight function would miss bottlenecks that are prominent under a different metric, confirming that multi-view profiling is necessary.
595	% 排名不是冗余的：单一权重函数会遗漏在另一指标下突出的瓶颈，确认多视图 profiling 是必要的。
596	
597	Finally, we test whether the profiler can produce useful groups without any user-specified fields.
598	% 最后，我们测试分析器能否在不需要任何用户指定字段的情况下产生有用的分组。
599	We run the automatic stack-induction mode (\S\ref{sec:stacks}) on the same six tasks used in RQ2 and compare the resulting group count and localization quality against flat summaries and per-session grouping.
600	% 我们在 RQ2 使用的同样六个任务上运行自动栈诱导模式（\S\ref{sec:stacks}），将结果的分组数和定位质量与扁平摘要和固定会话下钻进行比较。
601	Induced stacks produce a median of 12 groups (versus 285 for per-session and 1 for flat), with 4/6 tasks generating variable-depth stacks.
602	% 诱导栈产生中位 12 个分组（固定会话 285 个，扁平 1 个），4/6 任务生成可变深度栈。
603	The induced stacks achieve lower AP than hand-specified stacks (median 0.276 vs 0.312) because they use only visible fields, but they reduce inspection work to 65.3\% versus flat summaries without requiring any user configuration.
604	% 诱导栈的 AP 低于手动配置栈（中位 0.276 vs 0.312），因为它们仅使用可见字段，但将检查工作量降至扁平摘要的 65.3\%，无需任何用户配置。
605	Automatic induction therefore provides a useful zero-configuration baseline: it loses some precision versus hand-specified stacks but still substantially outperforms flat summaries.
606	% 因此自动诱导提供了有用的零配置基线：它相比手动配置栈损失了一些精度，但仍然大幅优于扁平摘要。
607	
608	Figure~\ref{fig:flamegraph} shows the resulting flame graphs for the \texttt{tokens} and \texttt{files} views, illustrating that changing only the stack fields and weight function produces different aggregates from the same operations.
609	% Figure~\ref{fig:flamegraph} 展示了 \texttt{tokens} 和 \texttt{files} 视图的火焰图，说明仅改变栈字段和权重函数即可从同一组 operation 产生不同聚合。

662	Operation-stack profiling & 0 & 0.312 & 0.188 & 0.198 & 0.094 & 0.390 & 0.038 & 157.5 \\
663	Op-stack + oracle fields & 1 & 0.599 & 0.300 & 0.403 & 0.044 & 0.564 & 0.012 & --- \\
664	Oracle (hidden annotations) & 1 & 1.000 & 0.670 & 0.797 & 0.115 & 1.000 & 0.038 & --- \\
665	\bottomrule
666	\end{tabular}
667	\end{table*}
668	
669	Table~\ref{tab:localization} summarizes the results.
670	% Table~\ref{tab:localization} 总结了结果。
671	Flat summaries recover all positives but require inspecting everything (Work@5\,=\,1.0).
672	% 扁平摘要恢复所有正例但需要检查全部内容（Work@5 = 1.0）。
673	Per-session grouping finds a first positive quickly (WTFP\,=\,0.004) but fragments the workload into 285 groups with only 2.3\% top-five recall.
674	% 固定会话下钻快速找到首个正例（WTFP = 0.004），但将工作量碎片化为 285 个组，前五召回率仅 2.3\%。
675	Operation-stack profiling inspects 9.4\% of the work in the top five groups, recovers 39.0\% of positives within 30\% of the inspection budget, and reduces groups to 157.5.
676	% Operation stack 分析在前五组中检查 9.4\% 的工作量，在 30\% 检查预算内恢复 39.0\% 的正例，并将组数减少到 157.5。
677	
678	Figure~\ref{fig:rq2-tradeoff} visualizes this tradeoff: operation-stack profiling sits in the low-work, moderate-recall region.
679	% Figure~\ref{fig:rq2-tradeoff} 可视化了这一权衡：operation stack 分析位于低工作量、中等召回率区域。
680	The comparison also serves as evidence for the operation/operation-stack model (\S\ref{sec:design}).
681	% 该比较也作为 operation/operation stack 模型（\S\ref{sec:design}）的证据。
682	Per-session grouping and native hierarchy are alternative abstractions that fix the hierarchy at session or dataset boundaries.
683	% 固定会话下钻和原生层次是在会话或数据集边界固定层次的替代抽象。
684	Operation stacks subsume both as special cases (include \texttt{session} in the stack to reproduce per-session grouping; include \texttt{dataset} to reproduce the native hierarchy).
685	% Operation stack 将两者作为特例包含（栈中包含 \texttt{session} 重现固定会话分组；包含 \texttt{dataset} 重现原生层次）。
686	On localization, operation stacks improve top-five recall over per-session on 5/6 tasks, reduce median group count by 45\%, and save 90\% of inspection work versus flat summaries.
687	% 在定位方面，operation stack 在 5/6 任务上改进了相对固定会话的前五召回率，中位组数减少 45\%，比扁平摘要节省 90\% 的检查工作量。
688	Per-session grouping retains lower work-to-first-positive on 4/6 tasks, confirming that profilers and debuggers are complementary.
689	% 固定会话下钻在 4/6 任务上保持更低的首个正例工作量，确认分析器和调试器是互补的。
690	
691	\begin{figure}[t]
692	\centering
693	\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{figures/baseline-tradeoff.png}
694	\caption{RQ2: Inspection work vs.\ recall at 30\% inspection budget.
695	Operation-stack profiling (tagged) achieves low work (0.094) with moderate
696	recall (0.39), while flat requires full inspection and per-session
697	fragments into 285 groups. Oracle policies (large dots) are upper bounds.}
698	\Description{Scatter plot showing inspection work versus budget recall
699	for seven profiling policies.}
700	\label{fig:rq2-tradeoff}
701	\end{figure}
702	
703	Statistical validation supports these comparisons.
704	% 统计验证支持这些比较。
705	Bootstrap (10{,}000 resamples) and tag-permutation (2{,}000 trials) confirm that the AP differences are stable and exceed the 95\% confidence threshold on all six tasks.
706	% Bootstrap（10,000 次重采样）和标签置换（2,000 次试验）确认 AP 差异在所有六个任务上是稳定的，且超过 95\% 置信阈值。
707	
708	We also test whether stack depth matters by sweeping the induced-stack depth cap from 1 to 5 on the same six tasks and measuring AP and inspection work at each depth.
709	% 我们还通过在同样六个任务上将诱导栈深度上限从 1 扫到 5 来测试栈深度是否重要，并在每个深度测量 AP 和检查工作量。
710	AP peaks at depth 3 (median 0.287) while inspection work is lowest at depth 5 (median 0.473).
711	% AP 在深度 3 时达到峰值（中位 0.287），而检查工作量在深度 5 时最低（中位 0.473）。
712	Different tasks achieve their best AP at different depths (2, 3, 4, and 5), confirming that depth should be tuned per objective rather than fixed globally.
713	% 不同任务在不同深度（2、3、4 和 5）达到最佳 AP，确认深度应按目标调整而非全局固定。
714	
715	The profiler's configuration is also actionable.
716	% 分析器的配置也是可操作的。
717	Modifying stack fields, mapping rules, or ranking criteria and re-running on the same operations improves AP on 5/6 tasks (median AP improvement 0.038), confirming that the profiler exposes useful tuning knobs rather than requiring a fixed configuration.
718	% 修改栈字段、映射规则或排名标准并在相同 operation 上重新运行，在 5/6 任务上改进了 AP（中位 AP 改进 0.038），确认分析器暴露了有用的调节旋钮而非需要固定配置。
719	
720	%% -------------------------------------------------------------------
721	\subsection{RQ3: How Accurate Are the Tags?}
722	% RQ3：标签有多准确？
723	
724	RQ1 and RQ2 assume that semantic tags (the tags derived by intent attribution or mapping rules) are useful.
725	% RQ1 和 RQ2 假设语义标签（由意图归因或映射规则派生的标签）是有用的。
726	RQ3 tests whether these semantic tags are accurate by comparing them against ground-truth annotations from the benchmark datasets.
727	% RQ3 通过将这些语义标签与基准数据集的真实标注进行比较来测试它们是否准确。
728	For real trajectories with natural-language prompts, we measure whether the intent-attribution backends run reliably at scale and produce well-formed tags.
729	% 对于自然语言轨迹（真实会话），我们测量意图归因后端是否在规模上可靠运行并产生格式良好的标签。
730	Semantic accuracy of the LLM/regex tagger on natural-language prompts remains future work because none of the available datasets (67{,}304 rows across 6 sources) simultaneously expose natural-language text and ground-truth semantic tags, making same-input accuracy evaluation infeasible with current data.
731	% LLM/正则标注器在自然语言提示词上的语义精度仍是未来工作，因为现有数据集（6 个来源共 67,304 行）没有同时暴露自然语言文本和真实语义标签，使得同输入精度评估在当前数据下不可行。
732	
733	On 325 real trajectories, the LLM tagger processes 118{,}021 tag requests with zero failures, 100\% syntax validity, and 70\% cache hit rate (operational details in RQ4).
734	% 在 325 个真实会话上，LLM 标注器处理了 118,021 个标注请求，零失败，100\% 语法有效性，70\% 缓存命中率（运行细节见 RQ4）。
735	
736	Public benchmark datasets provide native action annotations that serve as ground truth for mapping quality.
737	% 公开基准数据集提供原生操作标签作为映射质量的真实标准。
738	We run a leave-dataset-out evaluation.
739	% 我们运行留一数据集评估。
740	For each of 9 datasets, we train mapping rules on the other 8 and measure V-measure between the mapping-derived \texttt{phase} field and the dataset's native \texttt{action} annotations, plus boundary F1 between mapped phase boundaries and native action boundaries.
741	% 对于 9 个数据集中的每一个，我们在其余 8 个上训练映射规则，测量映射衍生的 \texttt{phase} 字段与数据集原生 \texttt{action} 标签之间的 V-measure，以及映射阶段边界与原生操作边界之间的边界 F1。
742	
743	\begin{figure}[t]
744	\centering
745	\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{figures/fig-rq3-vmeasure.pdf}
746	\caption{RQ3: Leave-dataset-out mapping quality on 13{,}265 operations
747	across 9 held-out datasets.
748	Dark bars: V-measure (cluster agreement between mapping-derived
749	\texttt{phase} and native \texttt{action} annotations).
750	Light bars: boundary F1 (precision/recall of phase transitions).
751	``---'': boundary evaluation inapplicable.
752	Dashed line marks 0.7; seven of nine datasets exceed it on both metrics.}
753	\Description{Grouped bar chart showing V-measure and boundary F1 for
754	nine held-out datasets, with a dashed threshold line at 0.7.}
755	\label{fig:rq3-vmeasure}
756	\end{figure}
757	
758	Figure~\ref{fig:rq3-vmeasure} shows the results.
759	% Figure~\ref{fig:rq3-vmeasure} 展示了结果。
760	V-measure quantifies whether the mapping groups operations into the same clusters as the ground-truth annotations; boundary F1 measures whether phase-transition points align.
761	% V-measure 量化映射是否将 operation 分组到与真实标注相同的簇；边界 F1 测量阶段转换点是否对齐。
762	Seven of nine datasets exceed 0.7 on both metrics, meaning rules trained on other families generalize: they assign operations to the correct semantic phase and detect transitions accurately.
763	% 9 个数据集中有 7 个在两个指标上都超过 0.7，表明在其他家族上训练的规则可泛化。
764	The two low-scoring datasets (toolbench, api-bank) use atypical action vocabularies absent from the training families, confirming that the mapping is pattern-based and degrades predictably when vocabulary shifts.
765	% 两个低分数据集（toolbench、api-bank）使用训练家族中不存在的非典型操作词汇，确认映射是基于模式的，在词汇变化时可预测地退化。
766	
767	Supervised boundary predictors beat simple baselines on 4/5 tested datasets (e.g., F1~0.77 vs 0.71 on OSWorld-Human), confirming that mapping rules produce useful tags but are not automatic intent discovery.
768	% 有监督的边界预测器在 4/5 测试的数据集上超过简单基线（例如 OSWorld-Human 上 F1 约 0.77 vs 0.71），确认映射规则产生有用标签但不是自动意图发现。
769	
770	%% -------------------------------------------------------------------
771	\subsection{RQ4: What Is the Profiling Cost?}
772	% RQ4：分析开销是多少？
773	
774	\sys is an offline, post-hoc profiler, so it adds zero overhead to the agent's runtime.
775	% \sys 是离线事后分析器，对智能体运行时不增加任何开销。
776	The profiling cost is the time and resources spent after the session ends.
777	% 分析开销是会话结束后花费的时间和资源。
778	
779	We re-execute 76 tracked profiling configurations twice (152 invocations) to measure cost and verify determinism.
780	% 我们重新执行 76 个跟踪的 profiling configuration 两次（152 次调用）来测量开销并验证确定性。
781	All 76 configurations produce byte-identical output across both runs.
782	% 全部 76 个配置在两次运行中产生字节相同的输出。
783	Median profiling time is 1.6\,s per configuration (p95 2.8\,s, max 4.3\,s), and median output size is 37.5\,KB.
784	% 中位分析时间为每配置 1.6 秒（p95 2.8 秒，最大 4.3 秒），中位输出大小为 37.5 KB。
785	The slowest configurations process views with over 600 unique stacks, while the 60 robustness configurations all complete within 1.6\,s.
786	% 最慢的配置处理超过 600 个唯一栈的视图，而 60 个稳健性配置全部在 1.6 秒内完成。
787	The full configuration space (operation files, query predicates, ranking criteria, and stack depth) stays deterministic across all 12 tested variants.
788	% 完整的配置空间（operation 文件、查询谓词、排名标准和栈深度）在所有 12 个测试变体中保持确定性。
789	
790	Intent attribution adds a one-time cost for new prompts.
791	% 意图归因对新提示词增加一次性开销。
792	Of 118{,}021 tag requests on 325 real trajectories, 70\% are cache hits (zero cost), and the remaining 35{,}136 new calls complete at p95 latency of 31\,ms per tag using a local 3B-parameter model.
793	% 在 325 个真实会话的 118,021 个标注请求中，70\% 为缓存命中（零开销），其余 35,136 个新调用使用本地 3B 参数模型以 p95 延迟 31 毫秒/标签完成。
794	Grammar-constrained decoding ensures 100\% syntax validity (2{,}700/2{,}700 test tags).
795	% 语法约束解码确保 100\% 语法有效性（2,700/2,700 测试标签）。
796	Because tags are cached, re-profiling the same trajectories with different stack fields or predicates incurs no additional LLM calls.
797	% 因为标签被缓存，用不同栈字段或谓词重新分析相同会话不产生额外 LLM 调用。
798	
799	
800	%% ===================================================================
801	\section{Related Work}
802	% 相关工作
803	
804	Agent observability
805	tools~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel,openinference,agentops,agenttelemetry,agenttraces-trust}
806	focus on single-execution debugging.
807	% 智能体可观测性工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel,openinference,agentops,agenttelemetry,agenttraces-trust}聚焦于单次执行调试。
808	Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} and
809	Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} cluster inputs or extract signals but
810	characterize input distributions, not resource attribution.
811	% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 和 Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 聚类输入或提取信号，但刻画的是输入分布而非资源归因。
812	AgentRx~\cite{agentrx}, TELBench~\cite{telbench},
813	AgentAtlas~\cite{agentatlas}, TrajAD~\cite{trajad}, and
814	AgentFixer~\cite{agentfixer} perform per-trajectory fault
815	localization.
816	% AgentRx~\cite{agentrx}、TELBench~\cite{telbench}、AgentAtlas~\cite{agentatlas}、TrajAD~\cite{trajad} 和 AgentFixer~\cite{agentfixer} 执行逐轨迹故障定位。
817	\sys complements all of these with category-level aggregate profiling
818	across trajectories.
819	% \sys 以跨轨迹的类别级聚合 profiling 补充所有这些工具。
820	
821	%% ===================================================================
822	\section{Conclusion}
823	% 结论
824	
825	Agent observability needs profiling, not only debugging.
826	% 智能体可观测性需要性能分析，不仅仅是调试。
827	\sys shows that the semantic operation stack model, with pluggable intent attribution and stack construction, brings hierarchical attribution to agent trajectories.
828	% \sys 表明，语义 operation stack 模型结合可插拔的意图归因和栈构造，为智能体轨迹带来了分层归因能力。
829	Scoring profiler output against hidden trajectory annotations confirms that semantic profiling separates over 90\% of system-effect cost that per-session views leave mixed, localizes annotated problems at 9.4\% inspection work versus flat summaries, and produces tags that agree with ground truth on 7/9 held-out datasets.
830	% 将分析器输出与隐藏轨迹标签评分确认，语义分析分离了超过 90\% 的混合系统副作用权重，以扁平摘要 9.4\% 的检查工作量定位标注问题，并在 7/9 保留数据集上产生与真实标签一致的标签。
831	Per-session grouping remains faster to a first positive on 4/6 tasks, confirming that profilers and debuggers are complementary, and \sys supports both by including or excluding session fields in the stack query.
832	% 固定会话下钻在 4/6 任务上更快找到首个正例，确认分析器和调试器是互补的，\sys 通过在栈查询中包含或排除会话字段同时支持两者。
833	Multi-project evaluation and tracing-ecosystem integration are the most impactful next steps.
834	% 多项目评估和 tracing 生态系统集成是最有影响力的下一步。
835

837	\bibliography{references}
838

\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}

\newcommand{\sys}{\textsc{AgentProf}\xspace}
\newcommand{\operation}{\texttt{operation}\xspace}
\newcommand{\opstack}{\texttt{operation stack}\xspace}

\begin{document}

\title{AgentProf: Semantic Profiling for AI Agents}

\begin{abstract}
%% S1: Context (→¶1)
AI agents increasingly orchestrate long-running, multi-step
activities involving thousands to millions of interactions with
users, tools, and system resources.
% AI 智能体编排长时间运行的多步骤活动，涉及与用户、工具和系统资源的数千到数百万次交互。
%% S2: Need (→¶2)
To improve quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers need to
determine which task categories consume the most budget, where
failures concentrate, and which workflows trigger unsafe effects.
% 为了提高质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要确定哪类任务消耗最多预算、故障集中在哪里、哪些工作流触发不安全副作用。
%% S3: Traditional profiling (→¶2+¶4)
To answer similar questions in traditional systems software, profiling
attributes resource consumption to responsible entities, such as code
paths, by aggregation, rather than single-execution debugging or
tracing.
% 在传统系统软件中，profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体（如代码路径），而非单次执行调试或 tracing。
%% S4: Gap (→¶2+¶3)
Yet existing agent observability tools are mainly for debugging and
tracing instead of profiling.
% 然而现有智能体可观测性工具主要用于调试和 tracing，而非 profiling。
%% S5: Agent challenge (→¶4)
Agent behavior differs fundamentally from code execution.
The responsible entities are semantic categories such as task intent
and workflow phase, not code paths, and agent trajectories lack the
stable identifiers and structural hierarchies that make
attribution possible.
% 智能体行为与代码执行有根本不同。负责实体是语义类别（如任务意图和工作流阶段），而非代码路径，且智能体轨迹缺乏使归因成为可能的稳定标识符和结构层次。
%% S6: Model (→¶5)
We propose a \emph{semantic operation stack model} that
adapts profiling to agent trajectories.
Uniform \emph{operations} represent all agent activities, and
\emph{operation stacks} replace the runtime call stack,
enabling hierarchical attribution at different levels of
granularity from the same data.
% 我们提出将 profiling 适配到智能体轨迹的语义 operation stack 模型。统一的 operation 表示所有智能体活动，operation stack 替代运行时调用栈，使同一数据支持不同粒度的分层归因。
%% S7: System (→¶6)
\sys implements this model as a profiler with pluggable algorithms
for \emph{intent attribution} and \emph{stack construction},
compiling local agent trajectories into pprof-compatible profiles.
% \sys 将此模型实现为具有可插拔意图归因和栈构造算法的 profiler，将本地智能体轨迹编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile。
%% S8: Results (→¶6)
On real trajectories and public datasets, our evaluation shows that
semantic profiling effectively attributes cost and locates problems
across agent trajectories.
% 在真实轨迹和公开数据集上，我们的评估表明语义 profiling 能有效地跨智能体轨迹归因开销和定位问题。
\end{abstract}

\maketitle

%% ===================================================================
\section{Introduction}
\label{sec:intro}

%% ¶1: Background + context
AI agents~\cite{sweagent,claudecode,osworld} orchestrate multi-step activities that span two layers, high-level intent (prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations) and low-level system effects (process spawns, file and network I/O).
% AI 智能体~\cite{sweagent,claudecode,osworld}编排跨越两层的多步骤活动：高层意图（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用）和低层系统副作用（进程创建、文件和网络 I/O）。
As agents evolve from short, scripted workflows into complex systems that run for hours and days, with a large number of interactions each, production teams accumulate many such trajectories over weeks or months.
% 随着智能体从短小的脚本化工作流进化为每次运行数小时、包含数千次交互的复杂系统，生产团队在数周或数月内积累大量此类轨迹。

%% ¶2: Problem
To improve agent quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers
need to analyze operational behavior across trajectories and
interactions.
Which categories of tasks consume the most token budget? Where do
failures concentrate across workflows? Which behavioral patterns
trigger unsafe system effects?
% 为了提高智能体质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要跨轨迹和交互分析运维行为。哪类任务消耗最多 token 预算？故障跨工作流集中在哪里？哪些行为模式触发不安全系统副作用？
Answering these questions requires analysis and evaluation across many
trajectories~\cite{agentatlas,agentrewardbench}, a task becoming costly for manual inspection or
per-trajectory LLM evaluation~\cite{llm-as-judge} at scale.
% 回答这些问题需要跨许多轨迹的分析和评估，在规模化时人工检查或逐轨迹 LLM 评估的成本越来越高。
In traditional systems software, profiling answers these questions by
attributing resource consumption to responsible entities by
aggregation, as distinct from single-execution debugging and tracing.
% 在传统系统软件中，profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体来回答这些问题，区别于单次执行调试和 tracing。

%% ¶3: Existing solutions
Yet existing agent tools support debugging and tracing but not
profiling (\S\ref{sec:background}).
% 然而现有智能体工具支持调试和 tracing，但不支持 profiling（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
Some~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel} organize events into
per-execution span trees, effective for diagnosing a single run but
unable to aggregate by semantic category.
% 一些工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel}将事件组织为按执行划分的 span 树，有效诊断单次运行但无法按语义类别聚合。
Others~\cite{datadog-llmobs,laminar-signals} cluster inputs or
extract structured signals, but characterize \emph{input
distributions} (``30\% of users ask code questions'') rather than
\emph{resource attribution} (``review tasks consume 40\% of the
token budget''), because tags at the request level do not propagate
to downstream tool calls and system effects.
% 另一些~\cite{datadog-llmobs,laminar-signals}聚类输入或提取结构化信号，但刻画的是输入分布（"30\% 的用户提问代码问题"）而非资源归因（"review 任务消耗了 40\% 的 token 预算"），因为请求级的标签不会传播到下游工具调用和系统副作用。

%% ¶4: Challenge — why traditional profiling doesn't transfer directly
Adapting profiling to agent trajectories is challenging
(\S\ref{sec:background}).
% 将 profiling 适配到智能体轨迹具有挑战性（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
In traditional software, the responsible entities are code paths.
Profiling is straightforward because function names are
stable and runtime call nesting provides the attribution
hierarchy (\S\ref{sec:background}).
% 在传统软件中，负责实体是代码路径。Profiling 是直接的，因为函数名是稳定的，运行时调用嵌套提供归因层次。
Agent behavior differs fundamentally.
To answer the questions above, the responsible entities need to be
semantic categories such as task intent and tool operation, not code
paths.
% 智能体行为有根本不同。要回答上述问题，负责实体需要是语义类别（如任务意图和工具操作），而非代码路径。
Agent trajectories lack the two properties that make traditional profiling possible.
% 智能体轨迹缺乏使传统 profiling 成为可能的两个特性。
Prompts are natural language, so two prompts expressing the same intent share no common string.
% 提示词是自然语言，表达相同意图的两个提示词没有共同字符串。
Agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy because prompts,
tool calls, and system effects are not nested by execution the way
function calls produce stack frames: a sequence of prompts can be a task or multiple tasks, a task can be part of a bigger task.
% 智能体事件没有运行时调用栈层次，因为提示词、工具调用和系统副作用不像函数调用那样通过执行嵌套产生栈帧。

%% ¶5: Model
Despite these differences, the fundamental profiling methodology
transfers to agent trajectories: project resources onto responsible
entities, assign stable tags, and attribute hierarchically.
% 尽管有这些差异，基本的 profiling 方法论可以迁移到智能体轨迹：将资源投影到负责实体、赋予稳定标签、分层归因。
We propose a \emph{semantic operation stack model} with two
components.
% 我们提出一个包含两个组件的语义 operation stack 模型。
\emph{Operations} are uniform records with string fields and
additive measures that represent all agent activities (prompts, LLM
calls, tool invocations, and system effects) without type-specific
objects.
% Operation 是带有字符串字段和可加度量的统一记录，表示所有智能体活动（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用），无需特定类型对象。
\emph{Operation stacks} provide hierarchical attribution, replacing the runtime call stack.
% Operation stack 提供分层归因，替代运行时调用栈。
Choosing different fields changes the attribution granularity: the same operations can be attributed by task category, by execution phase, by session, or by action type (Figure~\ref{fig:flamegraph}).
% 选择不同字段改变归因粒度：同一组 operation 可按任务类别、执行阶段、会话或操作类型归因（Figure~\ref{fig:flamegraph}）。

We implement this model in \sys, an offline profiler that compiles
local agent trajectories into pprof-compatible profiles
(Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}).
% 我们在 \sys 中实现此模型，这是一个离线 profiler，将本地智能体轨迹编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile（Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}）。
Two pluggable algorithm frameworks enrich the model.
% 两个可插拔算法框架丰富此模型。
\emph{Intent attribution} derives stable, low-cardinality tags from natural-language fields via regex rules, a local LLM tagger, or unsupervised clustering.
% 意图归因通过正则规则、本地 LLM 标注器或无监督聚类从自然语言字段派生稳定、低基数的标签。
This gives agents the stable tags that traditional profiling gets
for free from function names.
% 这为智能体提供了传统 profiling 从函数名免费获得的稳定标签。
\emph{Stack construction} builds the attribution hierarchy, either from a user-specified field list or by automatically detecting boundaries between distinct work phases.
% 栈构造构建归因层次，可通过用户指定的字段列表或自动检测不同工作阶段之间的边界。
On 325 real Codex and Claude trajectories (183{,}714 system
observations), semantic profiling separates over 90\% of
system-effect cost that per-session views cannot attribute to task
categories.
% 在 325 个真实 Codex 和 Claude 轨迹（183,714 个系统观测）上，语义 profiling 分离了按会话视图无法归因到任务类别的超过 90\% 的系统副作用开销。
On four public datasets (34{,}539 operations) where the correct

\section{Background and Motivation}
\label{sec:background}

\subsection{LLMs and AI Agents}
% AI 智能体

A typical agent trajectory interleaves two layers of activity.
% 典型的智能体轨迹交织两层活动。
At the intent layer, the agent receives a user prompt, issues LLM
calls, and invokes tools (code execution, web search, file editing).
% 在意图层，智能体接收用户提示词、发出 LLM 调用并调用工具（代码执行、网络搜索、文件编辑）。
Each tool invocation triggers system effects at the lower layer:
process spawns, file reads and writes, and network requests.
% 每次工具调用在下层触发系统副作用：进程创建、文件读写和网络请求。
A single trajectory may contain hundreds of such intent-effect
cycles, and a production team accumulates many trajectories over
time.
% 单条轨迹可能包含数百个这样的意图-副作用循环，生产团队随时间积累许多轨迹。

\subsection{System Profiling}
% 系统 Profiling

Profiling attributes resource consumption to responsible entities by
aggregation, as distinct from single-execution debugging and
tracing.
% Profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体，区别于单次执行调试和 tracing。
In traditional software, the profiling pipeline works as follows:
a profiler periodically samples execution state, attaches each
sample to the current call stack, and merges samples with identical
stacks.
% 在传统软件中，profiling 管线如下工作：profiler 周期性采样执行状态，将每个样本附加到当前调用栈，合并具有相同栈的样本。
Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} and pprof~\cite{pprof} call graphs
visualize the result, where width or node size represents aggregate
cost.
% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}和 pprof~\cite{pprof} 调用图可视化其结果，宽度或节点大小代表聚合开销。
Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} generalizes this with SQL-based analysis
and derived events.
% Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} 通过基于 SQL 的分析和衍生事件进行泛化。
These tools support flexible aggregation, but they all assume
stable function names and a runtime call stack.
% 这些工具支持灵活聚合，但都假设稳定的函数名和运行时调用栈。
Pprof's \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} options can add
label-derived pseudo-frames, but only on top of an existing execution
stack that agent trajectories do not have.
% Pprof 的 \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} 选项可以添加标签衍生的伪帧，但仅在智能体轨迹不具备的已有执行栈之上。

\subsection{Challenges for Agent Profiling}
% 智能体 Profiling 的挑战

Existing tools~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel} record agent
events as per-execution span trees, effective for debugging a single
run.
% 现有工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel}将智能体事件记录为按执行划分的 span 树，有效调试单次运行。
AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} bridges intent and system-effect layers
by correlating eBPF-captured system events with intercepted LLM
traffic, but the resulting recordings still lack aggregate profiling.
% AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} 通过关联 eBPF 捕获的系统事件与拦截的 LLM 流量来桥接意图层和系统副作用层，但生成的记录仍缺乏聚合分析能力。


Adapting profiling to agent trajectories faces two core challenges.
% 将 profiling 适配到智能体轨迹面临两个核心挑战。
The first is that the responsible entities differ.
% 第一个挑战是负责实体不同。
In traditional software, profiling attributes cost to code paths, but
in agent trajectories the relevant entities are semantic categories
such as task intent and workflow phase.
% 在传统软件中，profiling 将开销归因到代码路径，但在智能体轨迹中，相关实体是语义类别（如任务意图和工作流阶段）。
Existing tools~\cite{otel,openinference} do not capture these categories because prompts are natural language: two prompts and tool invocations expressing the same intent may be different, so the profiler cannot aggregate them the way it aggregates identical function names.
% 现有工具无法捕获这些类别，因为提示词是自然语言：表达相同意图的两个提示词可能措辞不同，因此分析器无法像聚合相同函数名那样聚合它们。
The second challenge is that agent trajectories have no runtime hierarchy for attribution.
% 第二个挑战是智能体轨迹没有运行时归因层次。
In CPU profiling, the call stack determines attribution at every level: \texttt{malloc}'s cost belongs to \texttt{parse}, to \texttt{process}, and to \texttt{main} simultaneously.
% 在 CPU 分析中，调用栈决定了每个层级的归因：\texttt{malloc} 的开销同时属于 \texttt{parse}、\texttt{process} 和 \texttt{main}。
A sequence of prompts may constitute one task or several, and a task may be part of a larger workflow, but no runtime mechanism marks these boundaries or determines at which granularity to attribute cost.
% 一串提示词可能构成一个任务也可能是多个任务，一个任务可能是更大工作流的一部分，但没有运行时机制标记这些边界或决定在哪个粒度归因开销。
We quantify this in RQ1~(\S\ref{sec:eval}).
% 我们在 RQ1~(\S\ref{sec:eval}) 中量化了这一点。

\subsection{Design Requirements for Agent Profiling}
% 智能体 Profiling 的设计需求

Traditional profiling relies on three mechanisms that the call stack provides automatically.
% 传统 profiling 依赖调用栈自动提供的三种机制。
Agent profiling needs all three but must achieve them without a call stack:
% 智能体 profiling 需要这三种机制，但必须在没有调用栈的情况下实现：

\begin{description}
\item[R1: Cross-layer resource projection.]
In traditional profiling, each sample is taken inside a call context, so resource consumption is automatically attributed to the code path that caused it.
% 在传统 profiling 中，每个采样在调用上下文内完成，因此资源消耗自动归因到造成它的代码路径。
Agent activities span two layers: intent (prompts, LLM calls) and system effects (file I/O, process spawns).
% 智能体活动跨越两层：意图（提示词、LLM 调用）和系统副作用（文件 I/O、进程创建）。
The profiler must connect system-layer resource consumption to intent-layer semantic categories.
% 分析器必须将系统层的资源消耗连接到意图层的语义类别。
\item[R2: Stable tags for folding.]
In traditional profiling, function names are stable identifiers that enable folding identical stacks.
% 在传统 profiling 中，函数名是稳定标识符，能够折叠相同的栈。
Agent prompts are natural language, so the profiler must derive short, stable, repeatable tags before folding.
% 智能体提示词是自然语言，因此分析器必须在折叠前派生短小、稳定、可重复的标签。
\item[R3: Hierarchical attribution.]
In traditional profiling, the runtime call stack provides the attribution hierarchy: function calls nest, and folding identical stacks produces the tree that profiles visualize.
% 在传统 profiling 中，运行时调用栈提供归因层次：函数调用嵌套，折叠相同的栈产生 profile 可视化的树。
Agent events are not nested by execution, so the profiler must construct attribution hierarchies from the data.
% 智能体事件没有执行嵌套，因此分析器必须从数据中构造归因层次。
\end{description}

%% ===================================================================
\section{Design}
% 设计
\label{sec:design}

The three requirements (cross-layer resource projection, stable tags, and hierarchical attribution) drive the design.
% 三个需求（跨层资源投影、稳定标签和分层归因）驱动了设计。
Operations (\S\ref{sec:ops}) satisfy R1 by representing intent and system-effect activities in a single record with tag inheritance, so intent-layer tags propagate to the system effects they trigger.
% Operation（\S\ref{sec:ops}）通过将意图和系统副作用活动表示在带标签继承的单一记录中满足 R1，使意图层标签传播到其触发的系统副作用。
\emph{Intent attribution} (\S\ref{sec:intent}) satisfies R2 by deriving stable tags from natural-language fields.
% 意图归因（\S\ref{sec:intent}）通过从自然语言字段派生稳定标签满足 R2。
\emph{Operation stacks} (\S\ref{sec:stacks}) satisfy R3 by replacing the runtime call stack with query-time field projections that attribute resources at multiple levels of granularity, so the same data supports multiple views without rebuilding the input.
% Operation stack（\S\ref{sec:stacks}）通过以查询时字段投影替代运行时调用栈，在多个粒度层级归因资源来满足 R3，使同一数据支持多种视图而无需重建输入。
The profiling pipeline has four stages: (1)~parse raw trajectories into operations, (2)~enrich operations via intent attribution or mapping rules, (3)~project each operation onto a stack frame sequence chosen at query time, and (4)~fold operations with identical stacks, summing their weights.
% 分析管线有四个阶段：(1) 将原始轨迹解析为 operation，(2) 通过意图归因或映射规则丰富 operation，(3) 将每个 operation 投影到查询时选择的栈帧序列上，(4) 折叠具有相同栈的 operation 并求和权重。

\subsection{Semantic Operation Stack Model}
% 语义 Operation Stack 模型
\label{sec:ops}

%% ¶1: Operations
Because agent activities span both the intent and system-effect
layers described in \S\ref{sec:background}, a profiler should not
distinguish between them in the data representation.
% 由于智能体活动跨越 \S\ref{sec:background} 中描述的意图层和系统副作用层，分析器不应在数据表示层面区分它们。
\sys therefore represents every activity as a single abstraction, the
\operation, a weighted record with string fields and additive
measures.
% 因此 \sys 将每个活动表示为单一抽象——operation，一个带有字符串字段和可加度量的加权记录。
Each operation carries string fields (\texttt{project},
\texttt{agent}, \texttt{session}, \texttt{prompt\_tag},
\texttt{kind}, \texttt{model}, \texttt{path}, \texttt{domain},
\texttt{status}, \ldots) and additive measures (token count,
duration, event count).
% 每个 operation 携带字符串字段（\texttt{project}、\texttt{agent}、\texttt{session}、\texttt{prompt\_tag}、\texttt{kind}、\texttt{model}、\texttt{path}、\texttt{domain}、\texttt{status} 等）和可加度量（token 数、持续时间、事件数）。
A prompt, an LLM call, a tool invocation, a file read, a GUI click,
and a process event are all operations with the same schema, distinguished only by which fields carry values.
% 提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用、文件读取、GUI 点击和进程事件都是具有相同 schema 的 operation，仅通过哪些字段有值来区分。

%% ¶2: Operation Stacks
\label{sec:stacks}
An \opstack provides hierarchical attribution for agent trajectories, replacing the runtime call stack.
% 一个 operation stack 为智能体轨迹提供分层归因，替代运行时调用栈。
In CPU profiling, the call stack determines which code paths
share responsibility for a resource cost.
% 在 CPU 分析中，调用栈决定哪些代码路径共同承担资源开销。
An operation stack serves the same role: an ordered list of fields
$[f_1, f_2, \ldots, f_k]$ projects each operation $o$ to a frame
sequence $\langle o.f_1, o.f_2, \ldots, o.f_k \rangle$, and
operations with identical sequences are merged, summing their
weights.
% Operation stack 承担相同角色：有序字段列表 $[f_1, f_2, \ldots, f_k]$ 将每个 operation $o$ 投影到帧序列 $\langle o.f_1, o.f_2, \ldots, o.f_k \rangle$，具有相同序列的 operation 被合并，权重求和。
Unlike a call stack, the fields are chosen at query time, not
determined by execution.
% 与调用栈不同，字段在查询时选择，而非由执行决定。
The same operations can therefore be attributed as a flat task summary, a
per-session tree, a semantic phase/action hierarchy, or a
trajectory using the dataset's own annotations, and changing the fields changes the
attribution without changing the data.
% 因此同一组 operation 可归因为扁平任务摘要、固定会话树、语义阶段/操作层次或使用数据集自身标签的轨迹，改变字段即改变归因方式而无需改变数据。
Sessions and spans are optional operation fields, not fixed hierarchy levels, so the same data supports both debugging views
(include \texttt{session}) and aggregate profiling views (exclude
it).
% 会话和 span 是可选的 operation 字段而非固定层次级别，因此同一数据既支持调试视图（包含 \texttt{session}）也支持聚合 profiling 视图（排除它）。
A view is a triple $(\varphi, \sigma, w)$: a predicate
$\varphi$ selects which operations participate, a stack function
$\sigma = [f_1, \ldots, f_k]$ maps each operation to its frame
sequence, and a weight function $w$ assigns a nonnegative measure.
% 一个视图是三元组 $(\varphi, \sigma, w)$：谓词 $\varphi$ 选择参与的 operation，栈函数 $\sigma = [f_1, \ldots, f_k]$ 将每个 operation 映射到其帧序列，权重函数 $w$ 赋予非负度量。
Four built-in defaults (Table~\ref{tab:views}) answer common
questions.
% 四个内置默认视图（Table~\ref{tab:views}）回答常见问题。

\begin{table}[t]

\subsection{Algorithms}
% 算法
\label{sec:intent}

\paragraph{Intent attribution.}
% 意图归因。
Intent attribution maps natural-language prompts to short, stable,
repeatable tags, giving agent trajectories the stable identifiers that traditional
profiling gets for free from function names
(\S\ref{sec:background}).
% 意图归因将自然语言的提示词映射为短小、稳定、可重复的标签，为智能体轨迹提供传统 profiling 从函数名免费获得的稳定标识符（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
The framework supports three pluggable backends.
% 该框架支持三种可插拔后端。
Regex rules are the production default: rules have the form
\texttt{KIND:TAG=REGEX}, are evaluated in order (first match wins),
and the developer iterates with \sys until the unmatched rate drops
below 5\%, typically in 5--10 rounds.
% 正则规则是生产环境默认：规则格式为 \texttt{KIND:TAG=REGEX}，按顺序求值（首个匹配胜出），开发者与 \sys 迭代直到未匹配率降至 5\% 以下，通常需要 5--10 轮。
A local LLM tagger (e.g., a quantized 3B-parameter model via llama.cpp)
generates a single-word tag per prompt with grammar-constrained
decoding (forcing output to match a predefined token grammar) and caching.
% 本地 LLM 标注器（如通过 llama.cpp 运行的量化 3B 参数模型）通过语法约束解码（强制输出匹配预定义 token 语法）和缓存为每个提示词生成单词标签。
Unsupervised clustering via TF-IDF and K-Means discovers
natural prompt groups without predefined rules, feeding rule
authoring.
% 通过 TF-IDF 和 K-Means 的无监督聚类在没有预定义规则的情况下发现自然提示词分组，为规则编写提供输入。
For structured trajectories where action types and quality annotations are
explicit fields, mapping rules derive new fields from existing
ones (e.g., \texttt{phase:navigate=type:(click|scroll|key)}).
% 对于操作类型和质量标注是显式字段的结构化轨迹，映射规则从现有字段派生新字段（如 \texttt{phase:navigate=type:(click|scroll|key)}）。
All backends are pluggable, and a profiling configuration records the
complete analysis setup for deterministic replay.
% 所有后端都是可插拔的，profiling configuration 记录完整的分析配置以实现确定性重放。

\paragraph{Stack construction.}
% 栈构造。
Stack construction builds attribution hierarchies from
available fields.
% 栈构造从可用字段构建归因层次。
When users supply an ordered list of fields, the projection is direct.
% 当用户提供有序字段列表时，投影是直接的。
When no field list is supplied, \sys can induce operation stacks
automatically by scoring adjacent operations for topic changes,
field changes, and group consistency, then cutting at boundaries
where the evidence is strongest.
% 当不提供有序字段列表时，\sys 可以通过对相邻 operation 评分主题变化、字段变化和分组一致性来自动诱导 operation stack，然后在证据最强的边界处切分。
The induced stacks have variable depth, and a configurable depth cap
controls the granularity.
% 诱导的栈具有可变深度，可配置的深度上限控制粒度。
This mode produces coarser groups than hand-specified stacks but
requires no domain knowledge, making it useful for initial
exploration (\S\ref{sec:eval}).
% 此模式产生比手动指定栈更粗的分组，但不需要领域知识，适用于初始探索（\S\ref{sec:eval}）。

\section{Implementation}
% 实现
\label{sec:impl}

\sys is an offline, post-hoc profiler implemented as a Rust CLI (Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}).
% \sys 是一个离线、事后分析器，实现为 Rust CLI（Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}）。
It reads recorded trajectories, not live events.
% 它读取记录的轨迹，而非实时事件。
The \texttt{agent-session} crate reads Codex and Claude Code local JSONL history files and reconstructs prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations, and their triggered file and network effects.
% \texttt{agent-session} crate 读取 Codex 和 Claude Code 本地 JSONL 历史文件，重建提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用及其触发的文件和网络副作用。
Each prompt opens a span.
% 每个提示词打开一个 span。
LLM calls, tool calls, and system effects within that span inherit its semantic tag, connecting intent to system behavior without runtime instrumentation.
% 该 span 内的 LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用继承其语义标签，无需运行时插桩即可连接意图与系统行为。
Public benchmark datasets enter as operation JSONL with mapping rules deriving fields before stack construction.
% 公开基准数据集以 operation JSONL 形式进入，映射规则在栈构建之前派生字段。
Standard Chrome Trace Event format can also be imported, with non-\sys protocol fields preserved as operation fields.
% 标准 Chrome Trace Event 格式也可导入，非 \sys 协议字段作为 operation 字段保留。

Output formats include pprof protobuf (compatible with \texttt{go tool pprof -http}), folded-stack text (compatible with \texttt{flamegraph.pl}), standalone SVG flame graphs, and JSON summaries.
% 输出格式包括 pprof protobuf（兼容 \texttt{go tool pprof -http}）、折叠栈文本（兼容 \texttt{flamegraph.pl}）、独立 SVG 火焰图和 JSON 摘要。
Operations can also be exported as standard Chrome Trace Event JSON and re-imported with byte-identical folded output, enabling interoperability with trace viewers such as Perfetto.
% Operation 也可以导出为标准 Chrome Trace Event JSON 并重新导入，折叠输出字节相同，支持与 Perfetto 等 trace 查看器的互操作。
All outputs are deterministic given the same input and profiling configuration.
% 在相同输入和 profiling configuration 下，所有输出都是确定性的。

\sys is the offline profiling component of the AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} observability framework.
% \sys 是 AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} 可观测性框架的离线分析组件。
AgentSight provides real-time eBPF-based capture of SSL traffic, process events, and file/network effects.
% AgentSight 提供基于 eBPF 的实时 SSL 流量、进程事件和文件/网络副作用捕获。
\sys aggregates the recorded trajectories into semantic profiles, so the two are complementary: AgentSight answers ``what happened during this run'' (debugging), and \sys answers ``where did the budget go across runs'' (profiling).
% \sys 将记录的轨迹聚合为语义概要，因此两者互补：AgentSight 回答"这次运行发生了什么"（调试），\sys 回答"预算跨运行花在了哪里"（分析）。

\section{Evaluation}
% 评估
\label{sec:eval}

We use two classes of data.
% 我们使用两类数据。
\textbf{Real agent trajectories}: 325 readable local trajectories (198~Codex, 50~Claude, 77~Claude subagent) from a multi-month development project, containing 183{,}714 system observations.
% 真实智能体会话：来自一个多月开发项目的 325 个可读本地会话（198 个 Codex、50 个 Claude、77 个 Claude 子智能体），包含 183,714 个系统观测。
\textbf{Public annotated trajectories}: 15 families of real agent or human executions, totaling 47{,}590 operations through mapping rules.
% 公开标注轨迹：15 个真实智能体或人类执行的家族，通过映射规则共计 47,590 个 operation。
These cover web agents (WebLINX~\cite{weblinx}, Mind2Web~\cite{mind2web}, AgentTrek~\cite{agenttrek}, WebShop~\cite{webshop}), API agents (API-Bank~\cite{apibank}, ToolBench~\cite{toolbench}, tau-bench~\cite{taubench}), coding agents (SWE-agent~\cite{sweagent}), and mobile/GUI agents (AndroidCtrl~\cite{androidcontrol}, GUI-Odyssey~\cite{guiodyssey}, ScaleCUA~\cite{scalecua}).
% 涵盖 web 智能体（WebLINX、Mind2Web、AgentTrek、WebShop）、API 智能体（API-Bank、ToolBench、tau-bench）、编码智能体（SWE-agent）和移动/GUI 智能体（AndroidCtrl、GUI-Odyssey、ScaleCUA）。
Four families with ground-truth quality annotations (AgentRewardBench~\cite{agentrewardbench}, SATraj-OS~\cite{safactory}, AgentNet~\cite{agentnet}, OSWorld-Human~\cite{osworldhuman}) provide hidden annotations for RQ2.
% 四个具有真实质量标注的家族（AgentRewardBench、SATraj-OS、AgentNet、OSWorld-Human）为 RQ2 提供隐藏标签。
We measure semantic separation via the mixed-weight percentage defined in RQ1.
% 我们通过 RQ1 中定义的混合权重百分比测量语义分离度。
For localization quality (RQ2), we use average precision (AP, the area under the precision-recall curve when groups are ranked by suspected problem density), recall at various inspection budgets, and work-to-first-positive (the fraction of groups inspected before finding one positive).
% 对于定位质量（RQ2），我们使用平均精度（AP，按疑似问题密度排序分组时精确率-召回率曲线下面积）、不同检查预算下的召回率和首个正例工作量（找到一个正例前检查的分组比例）。
For tag agreement (RQ3), we use V-measure (a clustering-agreement score ranging from 0 to 1) and boundary F1.
% 对于标签一致性（RQ3），我们使用 V-measure（聚类一致性分数，范围 0 到 1）和边界 F1。

%% -------------------------------------------------------------------
\subsection{RQ1: Does Semantic Profiling Improve Resource Attribution?}
% RQ1：语义分析能否改善资源归因？

The strongest argument against semantic profiling is that traditional tools ``can already see the same information.''
% 反对语义分析的最强论点是传统工具"已经能看到相同信息"。
To test this, we run a semantic-axis ablation on 325 real Codex/Claude trajectories (183{,}714 system observations).
% 为了检验这一点，我们在 325 个真实 Codex/Claude 会话（183,714 个系统观测）上进行语义轴消融。
We progressively add tag axes (no tags, session only, prompt only, both) and measure the mixed-weight percentage, the fraction of system-effect cost in groups that mix observations from multiple task categories.
% 我们逐步添加标签轴（无标签、仅会话、仅提示词、两者兼有），测量混合权重百分比——混合了多个任务类别观测的桶中的系统副作用权重比例。
A lower mixed-weight percentage means the profiler correctly separates effects by task category.
% 更低的混合权重百分比意味着分析器正确地按任务类别分离了效果。
The residual percentage measures weight in groups where the majority category accounts for less than 90\% of the group, capturing partial mixing.
% 残余百分比测量多数类别占桶内不到 90\% 的权重，捕获部分混合。

Figure~\ref{fig:rq1-separation} shows the result.
% Figure~\ref{fig:rq1-separation} 展示了结果。
Without semantic tags, nearly all system-effect cost falls into mixed groups: a flat \texttt{cargo~test} counter shows 2{,}903 executions but cannot distinguish whether they came from \texttt{review}, \texttt{debug}, \texttt{refactor}, or \texttt{test} prompts.
% 没有语义标签时，几乎所有系统副作用权重落入混合桶：扁平的 \texttt{cargo test} 计数器显示 2,903 次执行，但无法区分来源。
The prompt tag is the decisive axis: it drops both mixed weight and residual by more than half and nearly doubles the number of unique stacks, because it separates observations that share the same system call but originate from different task intents.
% 提示词标签是决定性轴：它将混合权重和残余都降低一半以上，唯一栈数量几乎翻倍，因为它分离了共享相同系统调用但来自不同任务意图的观测。
The session tag alone barely helps because trajectories typically contain multiple intent phases.
% 仅会话标签几乎没有帮助，因为会话通常包含多个意图阶段。

A tag-permutation test (1{,}000 shuffles, $p = 0.001$) confirms the separation is not random.
% 标签置换测试（1,000 次洗牌，$p = 0.001$）确认分离不是随机的。
Semantic-tag quality is validated in RQ3.
% 语义标签质量在 RQ3 中验证。
This confirms that traditional tag-free tools cannot separate system effects by task intent; the prompt-level semantic tag is necessary for meaningful resource attribution.
% 这确认了传统无标签工具无法按任务意图分离系统副作用；提示词级语义标签对于有意义的资源归因是必要的。

Beyond tag separation, we test whether choosing different field selections for the operation stack produces views that flat grouping cannot.
% 除标签分离外，我们还测试为 operation stack 选择不同字段是否产生扁平分组无法产生的视图。
We take the same 13{,}265 operations from the four families with ground-truth annotations and fold them with five different field selections, counting how many distinct groups each produces.
% 我们取四个有真实标注的家族的同样 13,265 个 operation，用五种不同字段选择折叠，计算每种产生多少不同分组。
The same operations fold into 9~dataset groups, 57~phase groups, 226~semantic groups, 455~action groups, or 3{,}757~per-session groups by changing only the stack fields.
% 同样的 operation 仅通过改变栈字段即可折叠为 9 个数据集分组、57 个阶段分组、226 个语义分组、455 个操作分组或 3,757 个固定会话分组。
A flat GROUP BY on a single tag cannot produce these views because different stack depths answer different questions (budget by task vs.\ duplication by action vs.\ per-session detail).
% 单标签的扁平 GROUP BY 无法产生这些视图，因为不同栈深度回答不同问题（任务级预算 vs. 操作级重复 vs. 会话级下钻）。
The same model also covers all 15 public trajectory families without type-specific objects.
% 同一模型也覆盖了所有 15 个公开轨迹家族，无需特定类型对象。
This shows that operation stacks provide a multi-resolution view that flat grouping cannot: one model answers questions at dataset, phase, action, and session granularity by changing only the field selection.
% 这表明 operation stack 提供了扁平分组无法实现的多分辨率视图：一个模型仅通过改变字段选择就能在数据集、阶段、操作和会话粒度上回答问题。

A profiler that supports only one weight function (e.g., token count) might miss bottlenecks visible under a different metric. We test whether different weight functions produce redundant or distinct rankings on the same trajectories.
% 只支持一种权重函数（如 token 数）的分析器可能遗漏在另一指标下可见的瓶颈。我们测试不同权重函数在相同会话上产生冗余还是不同的排名。
The \texttt{time} and \texttt{tokens} views of the same 325 trajectories share only 7/10 top prompt categories (Spearman $\rho = 0.623$).
% 同一 325 个会话的 \texttt{time} 和 \texttt{tokens} 视图仅共享 7/10 的顶级提示词类别（Spearman $\rho = 0.623$）。
\texttt{network}-tagged prompts rank 8th by time (I/O wait) but 93rd by tokens.
% \texttt{network} 标记的提示词按时间排第 8（I/O 等待）但按 token 排第 93。
The rankings are not redundant: a single weight function would miss bottlenecks that are prominent under a different metric, confirming that multi-view profiling is necessary.
% 排名不是冗余的：单一权重函数会遗漏在另一指标下突出的瓶颈，确认多视图 profiling 是必要的。

Finally, we test whether the profiler can produce useful groups without any user-specified fields.
% 最后，我们测试分析器能否在不需要任何用户指定字段的情况下产生有用的分组。
We run the automatic stack-induction mode (\S\ref{sec:stacks}) on the same six tasks used in RQ2 and compare the resulting group count and localization quality against flat summaries and per-session grouping.
% 我们在 RQ2 使用的同样六个任务上运行自动栈诱导模式（\S\ref{sec:stacks}），将结果的分组数和定位质量与扁平摘要和固定会话下钻进行比较。
Induced stacks produce a median of 12 groups (versus 285 for per-session and 1 for flat), with 4/6 tasks generating variable-depth stacks.
% 诱导栈产生中位 12 个分组（固定会话 285 个，扁平 1 个），4/6 任务生成可变深度栈。
The induced stacks achieve lower AP than hand-specified stacks (median 0.276 vs 0.312) because they use only visible fields, but they reduce inspection work to 65.3\% versus flat summaries without requiring any user configuration.
% 诱导栈的 AP 低于手动配置栈（中位 0.276 vs 0.312），因为它们仅使用可见字段，但将检查工作量降至扁平摘要的 65.3\%，无需任何用户配置。
Automatic induction therefore provides a useful zero-configuration baseline: it loses some precision versus hand-specified stacks but still substantially outperforms flat summaries.
% 因此自动诱导提供了有用的零配置基线：它相比手动配置栈损失了一些精度，但仍然大幅优于扁平摘要。

Figure~\ref{fig:flamegraph} shows the resulting flame graphs for the \texttt{tokens} and \texttt{files} views, illustrating that changing only the stack fields and weight function produces different aggregates from the same operations.
% Figure~\ref{fig:flamegraph} 展示了 \texttt{tokens} 和 \texttt{files} 视图的火焰图，说明仅改变栈字段和权重函数即可从同一组 operation 产生不同聚合。

\caption{RQ1: Semantic-axis ablation on 183{,}714 system observations
from 325 real trajectories.
Bars show mixed weight and residual percentages (left axis);
the line shows unique stacks (right axis).
Adding prompt tags reduces mixed weight from 90.4\% to 36.7\%
while increasing unique stacks from 12k to 25k.
Session tags alone barely help (84.4\%).}
\Description{Grouped bar chart with dual y-axis showing mixed weight

\subsection{RQ2: Does Profiler Output Correspond to Real Problems?}
% RQ2：分析器输出是否对应真实问题？

RQ2 tests whether the profiler's top-ranked groups actually contain real failures, safety violations, or wasted effort.
% RQ2 测试分析器排名靠前的分组是否确实包含真实的故障、安全违规或浪费的算力。
We use public benchmark datasets that provide ground-truth quality annotations (failure, safety violation, redundant step, human-task boundary), hide these annotations from the profiler, and check whether the top-ranked groups recover them, analogous to injecting known bottlenecks in a CPU profiler evaluation.
% 我们使用提供真实质量标注（故障、安全违规、冗余步骤、人工任务边界）的公开基准数据集，对分析器隐藏这些标注，检查排名靠前的分组是否恢复了它们，类似于在 CPU 分析器评估中注入已知瓶颈。

The benchmark uses six tasks across four datasets (AgentRewardBench looping and side-effect, SATraj-OS unsafe operation, AgentNet incorrect and redundant step, and OSWorld-Human group start), totaling 34{,}539 operations and 3{,}699 positives.
% 基准使用四个数据集的六个任务（AgentRewardBench 循环和副作用、SATraj-OS 不安全操作、AgentNet 不正确和冗余步骤、OSWorld-Human 组起始），共计 34,539 个 operation 和 3,699 个正例。
We compare seven grouping strategies (flat summary, per-session grouping, native hierarchy, raw-action grouping, operation-stack profiling, operation-stack with oracle fields, and a full oracle that uses the hidden annotations) and rank groups by the fraction of hidden positives they contain.
% 我们比较七种分组策略（扁平摘要、固定会话分组、原生层次、原始操作分组、operation stack 分析、operation stack 加 oracle 字段，以及使用隐藏标签的完整 oracle），按组包含的隐藏正例比例对组排序。

% 我们还通过在同样六个任务上将诱导栈深度上限从 1 扫到 5 来测试栈深度是否重要，并在每个深度测量 AP 和检查工作量。

\subsection{RQ3: How Accurate Are the Tags?}
% RQ3：标签有多准确？

RQ1 and RQ2 assume that semantic tags (the tags derived by intent attribution or mapping rules) are useful.
% RQ1 和 RQ2 假设语义标签（由意图归因或映射规则派生的标签）是有用的。
RQ3 tests whether these semantic tags are accurate by comparing them against ground-truth annotations from the benchmark datasets.
% RQ3 通过将这些语义标签与基准数据集的真实标注进行比较来测试它们是否准确。
For real trajectories with natural-language prompts, we measure whether the intent-attribution backends run reliably at scale and produce well-formed tags.
% 对于自然语言轨迹（真实会话），我们测量意图归因后端是否在规模上可靠运行并产生格式良好的标签。
Semantic accuracy of the LLM/regex tagger on natural-language prompts remains future work because none of the available datasets (67{,}304 rows across 6 sources) simultaneously expose natural-language text and ground-truth semantic tags, making same-input accuracy evaluation infeasible with current data.
% LLM/正则标注器在自然语言提示词上的语义精度仍是未来工作，因为现有数据集（6 个来源共 67,304 行）没有同时暴露自然语言文本和真实语义标签，使得同输入精度评估在当前数据下不可行。

On 325 real trajectories, the LLM tagger processes 118{,}021 tag requests with zero failures, 100\% syntax validity, and 70\% cache hit rate (operational details in RQ4).
% 在 325 个真实会话上，LLM 标注器处理了 118,021 个标注请求，零失败，100\% 语法有效性，70\% 缓存命中率（运行细节见 RQ4）。

Public benchmark datasets provide native action annotations that serve as ground truth for mapping quality.
% 公开基准数据集提供原生操作标签作为映射质量的真实标准。
We run a leave-dataset-out evaluation.
% 我们运行留一数据集评估。
For each of 9 datasets, we train mapping rules on the other 8 and measure V-measure between the mapping-derived \texttt{phase} field and the dataset's native \texttt{action} annotations, plus boundary F1 between mapped phase boundaries and native action boundaries.
% 对于 9 个数据集中的每一个，我们在其余 8 个上训练映射规则，测量映射衍生的 \texttt{phase} 字段与数据集原生 \texttt{action} 标签之间的 V-measure，以及映射阶段边界与原生操作边界之间的边界 F1。

\begin{figure}[t]
\centering
\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{figures/fig-rq3-vmeasure.pdf}
\caption{RQ3: Leave-dataset-out mapping quality on 13{,}265 operations
across 9 held-out datasets.
Dark bars: V-measure (cluster agreement between mapping-derived
\texttt{phase} and native \texttt{action} annotations).
Light bars: boundary F1 (precision/recall of phase transitions).
``---'': boundary evaluation inapplicable.
Dashed line marks 0.7; seven of nine datasets exceed it on both metrics.}
\Description{Grouped bar chart showing V-measure and boundary F1 for
nine held-out datasets, with a dashed threshold line at 0.7.}
\label{fig:rq3-vmeasure}
\end{figure}

Figure~\ref{fig:rq3-vmeasure} shows the results.
% Figure~\ref{fig:rq3-vmeasure} 展示了结果。
V-measure quantifies whether the mapping groups operations into the same clusters as the ground-truth annotations; boundary F1 measures whether phase-transition points align.
% V-measure 量化映射是否将 operation 分组到与真实标注相同的簇；边界 F1 测量阶段转换点是否对齐。
Seven of nine datasets exceed 0.7 on both metrics, meaning rules trained on other families generalize: they assign operations to the correct semantic phase and detect transitions accurately.
% 9 个数据集中有 7 个在两个指标上都超过 0.7，表明在其他家族上训练的规则可泛化。
The two low-scoring datasets (toolbench, api-bank) use atypical action vocabularies absent from the training families, confirming that the mapping is pattern-based and degrades predictably when vocabulary shifts.
% 两个低分数据集（toolbench、api-bank）使用训练家族中不存在的非典型操作词汇，确认映射是基于模式的，在词汇变化时可预测地退化。

Supervised boundary predictors beat simple baselines on 4/5 tested datasets (e.g., F1~0.77 vs 0.71 on OSWorld-Human), confirming that mapping rules produce useful tags but are not automatic intent discovery.
% 有监督的边界预测器在 4/5 测试的数据集上超过简单基线（例如 OSWorld-Human 上 F1 约 0.77 vs 0.71），确认映射规则产生有用标签但不是自动意图发现。

%% -------------------------------------------------------------------
\subsection{RQ4: What Is the Profiling Cost?}
% RQ4：分析开销是多少？

\sys is an offline, post-hoc profiler, so it adds zero overhead to the agent's runtime.
% \sys 是离线事后分析器，对智能体运行时不增加任何开销。
The profiling cost is the time and resources spent after the session ends.
% 分析开销是会话结束后花费的时间和资源。

We re-execute 76 tracked profiling configurations twice (152 invocations) to measure cost and verify determinism.
% 我们重新执行 76 个跟踪的 profiling configuration 两次（152 次调用）来测量开销并验证确定性。
All 76 configurations produce byte-identical output across both runs.
% 全部 76 个配置在两次运行中产生字节相同的输出。
Median profiling time is 1.6\,s per configuration (p95 2.8\,s, max 4.3\,s), and median output size is 37.5\,KB.
% 中位分析时间为每配置 1.6 秒（p95 2.8 秒，最大 4.3 秒），中位输出大小为 37.5 KB。
The slowest configurations process views with over 600 unique stacks, while the 60 robustness configurations all complete within 1.6\,s.
% 最慢的配置处理超过 600 个唯一栈的视图，而 60 个稳健性配置全部在 1.6 秒内完成。
The full configuration space (operation files, query predicates, ranking criteria, and stack depth) stays deterministic across all 12 tested variants.
% 完整的配置空间（operation 文件、查询谓词、排名标准和栈深度）在所有 12 个测试变体中保持确定性。

Intent attribution adds a one-time cost for new prompts.
% 意图归因对新提示词增加一次性开销。
Of 118{,}021 tag requests on 325 real trajectories, 70\% are cache hits (zero cost), and the remaining 35{,}136 new calls complete at p95 latency of 31\,ms per tag using a local 3B-parameter model.
% 在 325 个真实会话的 118,021 个标注请求中，70\% 为缓存命中（零开销），其余 35,136 个新调用使用本地 3B 参数模型以 p95 延迟 31 毫秒/标签完成。
Grammar-constrained decoding ensures 100\% syntax validity (2{,}700/2{,}700 test tags).
% 语法约束解码确保 100\% 语法有效性（2,700/2,700 测试标签）。
Because tags are cached, re-profiling the same trajectories with different stack fields or predicates incurs no additional LLM calls.
% 因为标签被缓存，用不同栈字段或谓词重新分析相同会话不产生额外 LLM 调用。


%% ===================================================================
\section{Related Work}
% 相关工作

Agent observability
tools~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel,openinference,agentops,agenttelemetry,agenttraces-trust}
focus on single-execution debugging.
% 智能体可观测性工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel,openinference,agentops,agenttelemetry,agenttraces-trust}聚焦于单次执行调试。
Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} and
Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} cluster inputs or extract signals but
characterize input distributions, not resource attribution.
% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 和 Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 聚类输入或提取信号，但刻画的是输入分布而非资源归因。
AgentRx~\cite{agentrx}, TELBench~\cite{telbench},
AgentAtlas~\cite{agentatlas}, TrajAD~\cite{trajad}, and
AgentFixer~\cite{agentfixer} perform per-trajectory fault
localization.
% AgentRx~\cite{agentrx}、TELBench~\cite{telbench}、AgentAtlas~\cite{agentatlas}、TrajAD~\cite{trajad} 和 AgentFixer~\cite{agentfixer} 执行逐轨迹故障定位。
\sys complements all of these with category-level aggregate profiling
across trajectories.
% \sys 以跨轨迹的类别级聚合 profiling 补充所有这些工具。

%% ===================================================================
\section{Conclusion}
% 结论

Agent observability needs profiling, not only debugging.
% 智能体可观测性需要性能分析，不仅仅是调试。
\sys shows that the semantic operation stack model, with pluggable intent attribution and stack construction, brings hierarchical attribution to agent trajectories.
% \sys 表明，语义 operation stack 模型结合可插拔的意图归因和栈构造，为智能体轨迹带来了分层归因能力。
Scoring profiler output against hidden trajectory annotations confirms that semantic profiling separates over 90\% of system-effect cost that per-session views leave mixed, localizes annotated problems at 9.4\% inspection work versus flat summaries, and produces tags that agree with ground truth on 7/9 held-out datasets.
% 将分析器输出与隐藏轨迹标签评分确认，语义分析分离了超过 90\% 的混合系统副作用权重，以扁平摘要 9.4\% 的检查工作量定位标注问题，并在 7/9 保留数据集上产生与真实标签一致的标签。
Per-session grouping remains faster to a first positive on 4/6 tasks, confirming that profilers and debuggers are complementary, and \sys supports both by including or excluding session fields in the stack query.
% 固定会话下钻在 4/6 任务上更快找到首个正例，确认分析器和调试器是互补的，\sys 通过在栈查询中包含或排除会话字段同时支持两者。
Multi-project evaluation and tracing-ecosystem integration are the most impactful next steps.
% 多项目评估和 tracing 生态系统集成是最有影响力的下一步。

\bibliographystyle{ACM-Reference-Format}
\bibliography{references}

\end{document}

content.text:
"Attribution" 有三个用法：
1. **resource attribution** (L114) — 资源归因（profiling 的目标）
2. **intent attribution** (L64, L183, L342) — 意图归因（算法名，R2 的解法）
3. **hierarchical attribution** (L59, L171, L326, L374) — 分层归因（R3 的名字）

这三个含义是**不同但相关的**：resource attribution 是目标，intent attribution 和 hierarchical attribution 是实现手段。读者应该能从上下文区分。不需要改——但值得检查是否有混淆的地方。

让我报告完整审计结果：

---

## Terminology & Information Flow Audit Report

### Must fix

```
L382: "operations with identical sequences are merged"
  Category: C1 (synonym drift)
  Problem: Paper uses "fold/folded/folding" (10×) as the standard verb for combining
  identical stacks, but this one sentence uses "merged" (1×). Reader may wonder
  if "merge" means something different from "fold."
  Fix: "operations with identical sequences are folded, summing their weights"
```

### Should fix

```
L19-20: \newcommand{\operation} / \newcommand{\opstack}
  Category: X3 (term stability)
  Problem: Both macros typeset in \texttt{} (monospace), but each is used exactly
  once (L358, L374). The other ~100 occurrences of "operation" and "operation stack"
  are plain text. Inconsistent visual treatment of the paper's most central terms.
  Fix: Either use the macros consistently everywhere, or drop the \texttt{} from the
  macro definitions (change to plain text).
```

```
L575: "produces views that flat grouping cannot"
L585: "operation stacks provide a multi-resolution view"
  Category: C1 (synonym drift)
  Problem: RQ1 uses "views" (the informal sense) 4× without connecting to the formal
  definition of "view" as a triple (φ, σ, w) from §3.1 L397. The formal definition
  sits between the two usages but the eval never references it. Reader may not
  realize these are the same concept.
  Fix: Add "(as defined in §3)" on first eval use, or use "attribution views" to
  connect to the formal concept.
```

```
L680: "evidence for the operation/operation-stack model"
  Category: J1 (reviewer test)
  Problem: "operation/operation-stack model" is an awkward slash-compound never used
  elsewhere. The paper's name for this is "semantic operation stack model."
  Fix: "evidence for the semantic operation stack model (§3)"
```

### Consider

```
L183: "low-cardinality tags"
  Category: J6 (audience calibration)
  Problem: "low-cardinality" is a database term. AgenticOS workshop audience may not
  all know it immediately.
  Fix: "tags with a small fixed vocabulary" or "tags drawn from a small set"
```

```
L464: "profiling configuration"
  Category: C1
  Problem: Used 4× in eval (L464, L512, L779, L787) but never formally defined.
  Reader must infer it means "the complete set of choices (fields, rules, predicates)."
  Fix: Add a one-clause definition at first use in §3: "a profiling configuration
  (the complete analysis setup: field list, mapping rules, and predicates)"
```

---

### Summary

| Category | Must fix | Should fix | Consider |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 (synonym drift) | 1 | 2 | 1 |
| X3 (term stability) | — | 1 | — |
| J1/J6 (jargon) | — | 1 | 1 |

**Top 3 most impactful:**
1. L382 "merged" → "folded" — single inconsistency in the paper's core mechanism verb
2. L680 "operation/operation-stack model" → use the paper's proper name
3. L19-20 macro typography — visual inconsistency for the two most important terms

**Overall assessment:** The paper is now very clean on terminology. The R1/R2/R3 framing is consistent throughout. The label→tag and aggregation→attribution transitions are complete. The remaining issues are polish-level.

105	profiling (\S\ref{sec:background}).

668	% 该比较也作为 operation/operation stack 模型（\S\ref{sec:design}）的证据。
669	Per-session grouping and native hierarchy are alternative abstractions that fix the hierarchy at session or dataset boundaries.
670	% 固定会话下钻和原生层次是在会话或数据集边界固定层次的替代抽象。
671	Operation stacks subsume both as special cases (include \texttt{session} in the stack to reproduce per-session grouping; include \texttt{dataset} to reproduce the native hierarchy).
672	% Operation stack 将两者作为特例包含（栈中包含 \texttt{session} 重现固定会话分组；包含 \texttt{dataset} 重现原生层次）。
673	On localization, operation stacks improve top-five recall over per-session on 5/6 tasks, reduce median group count by 45\%, and save 90\% of inspection work versus flat summaries.
674	% 在定位方面，operation stack 在 5/6 任务上改进了相对固定会话的前五召回率，中位组数减少 45\%，比扁平摘要节省 90\% 的检查工作量。
675	Per-session grouping retains lower work-to-first-positive on 4/6 tasks, confirming that profilers and debuggers are complementary.
676	% 固定会话下钻在 4/6 任务上保持更低的首个正例工作量，确认分析器和调试器是互补的。
677	
678	Statistical validation supports these comparisons.
679	% 统计验证支持这些比较。
680	Bootstrap (10{,}000 resamples) and tag-permutation (2{,}000 trials) confirm that the AP differences are stable and exceed the 95\% confidence threshold on all six tasks.
681	% Bootstrap（10,000 次重采样）和标签置换（2,000 次试验）确认 AP 差异在所有六个任务上是稳定的，且超过 95\% 置信阈值。
682	
683	We also test whether stack depth matters by sweeping the induced-stack depth cap from 1 to 5 on the same six tasks and measuring AP and inspection work at each depth.
684	% 我们还通过在同样六个任务上将诱导栈深度上限从 1 扫到 5 来测试栈深度是否重要，并在每个深度测量 AP 和检查工作量。
685	AP peaks at depth 3 (median 0.287) while inspection work is lowest at depth 5 (median 0.473).
686	% AP 在深度 3 时达到峰值（中位 0.287），而检查工作量在深度 5 时最低（中位 0.473）。
687	Different tasks achieve their best AP at different depths (2, 3, 4, and 5), confirming that depth should be tuned per objective rather than fixed globally.
688	% 不同任务在不同深度（2、3、4 和 5）达到最佳 AP，确认深度应按目标调整而非全局固定。
689	
690	The profiler's configuration is also actionable.
691	% 分析器的配置也是可操作的。
692	Modifying stack fields, mapping rules, or ranking criteria and re-running on the same operations improves AP on 5/6 tasks (median AP improvement 0.038), confirming that the profiler exposes useful tuning knobs rather than requiring a fixed configuration.
